expr.description: Function of x using + - * / ^ ( ) and sqrt abs; e.g. "2x+1" or "x^2/4-3".

width.description: Drawing width in abstract units; y points up from 0 to height.

denominator.description: Label ticks as fractions with this denominator.

rows.description: Area model only: rows of the grid; parts must be divisible by rows.

value.description: Arithmetic that evaluates to the numeric/fraction answer, e.g. "3*4+2" or "3/4+1/8". Numbers, + - * / ^ ( ), sqrt(), abs(), round(x) or round(x, decimals), min(a, b), max(a, b), pi.

items.description: Items in the CORRECT order; the app shuffles them.
